notes_for_editor: The Forest Fire Lookout Association entry for Forse Mountain has an unknown structure type, so it is not confirmed that a tower stood here; the brief's kind 'unknown' is kept. The only other facts are about the natural summit (531 ft, Patroon South quad). The list's point is about 0.75 km north of the summit's own coordinates; the story says so but does not assume the lookout stood on the summit. Nothing read gives a build date, design, staffing, fires or fate beyond the Gone status. The Portal to Texas History search for Forse Mountain returned one 1950 Texas City Sun issue whose item page mentions no Forse; the OCR text was not checked. A PeakVisor search snippet gives Forse Mountain as 178 m, which conflicts with the 162 m on Mapcarta and MountainZone; PeakVisor was not read and is not cited. No photos added.
